title: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee
shortDescription: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee helps define a Game Boy Color platformer path in GameAtlas through a frozen catalog method and a direct Wikidata record.
highlights: Adds a clearly sourced platformer option to the Game Boy Color discovery path.
Pairs a frozen GameAtlas catalog method with a direct Wikidata structured-data record.

signals.label: GameAtlas catalog method
signals.rationale: Grouped for the Game Boy Color platformer discovery path using the frozen source metadata record; this remains a catalog-method note with no imported numerical signal.
